Q: pandas last 3 weeks same day average in groups A:

using a rolling last 3 rows

Don't do a rolling last 3 rows, do a rolling last 3 weeks instead. .rolling lets you specify a time offset.

P.S. That said, .rolling('3W', on='Date') doesn't work: ValueError: <3 * Weeks: weekday=6> is a non-fixed frequency. I think .rolling(f'{7*3}D', on='Date') is what you want. I'm awaiting clarification in the comments.

Q: Is it possible to negate a scope in Rails? A:

It is actually possible to define the negation of a scope without affecting conditions preceding the scope, by using merge in the scope definition:

scope :with_missing_coins, joins(:coins).where("coins.is_missing = ?", true)
scope :without_missing_coins, -> { merge(klass).with_missing_coins.invert_where }

This way, invert_where only affects the specified scope, with spilling into conditions preceding it (e.g. MyModel.where(foo).without_missing_coins.

Q: StartTime format for FilterHashtable in powershell? A:

Any string that converts to the [datetime] type should work:

[datetime]'1/1'

Wednesday, January 1, 2025 12:00:00 AM


[datetime]'12pm'

Wednesday, December 31, 2025 12:00:00 PM

Q: gitlab-ci: Terraform has no command named "sh". Did you mean "show" A:

You need to override the entrypoint in the terraform image so you have access to the shell.

image: 
  name: hashicorp/terraform:light
  entrypoint: [""]

before_script:
  - terraform init

validate:
  script:
    - terraform validate

You can also take a look at the official gitlab documentation how to integrate terraform with gitlab, as the have a template for that.
